newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN to repatriate 10,000 Somalis in Ethiopia.
newsitem.headline: UN to repatriate 10,000 Somalis in Ethiopia.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency UNHCR will repatriate up to 10,000 Somali refugees from Ethiopia over the next few weeks and hopes many more will join the homeward movement, a spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
Pamela O'Toole told a briefing in Geneva that the UNHCR signed an accord with the Addis Ababa government to start the repatriation next week to northwest Somalia.
Since 1988, camps in eastern Ethiopia along the border with northern Somalia have sheltered some 275,000 Somali refugees.

The UNHCR said 2,600 refugees in Teferi Bir camp had already signed up for voluntary repatriation and would be trucked home at a rate of 150 a day. Other camps were likely to follow suit, including Hartisheik, home to 59,000 Somalis.

The anarchic Horn of Africa country has been devastated by faction fighting since 1991 after rebels overthrew late president Mohamed Siad Barre and turned their guns on each other in vicious fighting which killed thousands of people.
